🎬 The Righteous Gemstones (2019–2025)

The Righteous Gemstones follows the wealthy and dysfunctional Gemstone family, a powerful dynasty of televangelists who have built a massive religious empire through their extravagant megachurches, television broadcasts, and devoted followers. Led by patriarch Eli Gemstone, the family enjoys enormous wealth, luxurious lifestyles, and celebrity-like status while presenting themselves as righteous spiritual leaders. However, behind their public image lies a chaotic world of greed, jealousy, family rivalries, hidden scandals, and outrageous behavior. Eli’s three adult children, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin, constantly compete for power, recognition, and control of the family’s religious empire, often creating ridiculous situations and disastrous consequences. As blackmail schemes, criminal threats, romantic complications, and shocking family secrets emerge, the Gemstones struggle to protect their reputation while confronting their own hypocrisy. Combining outrageous comedy, sharp satire, emotional family drama, and unpredictable twists, the series explores faith, wealth, corruption, ambition, loyalty, and the complicated relationships within a family determined to maintain its powerful legacy.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Dark Comedy • Crime • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 30–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Danny McBride

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max, with digital purchase options on select platforms such as Amazon Video and Apple TV. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Righteous Gemstones is an American crime comedy-drama television series created by Danny McBride that premiered on August 18, 2019, on HBO. The series follows a famous and dysfunctional family of televangelists. McBride also stars in the series, alongside Adam DeVine, Edi Patterson, Tony Cavalero, Cassidy Freeman, Gregory Alan Williams, Tim Baltz, and John Goodman. The series concluded on May 4, 2025, after airing four seasons and 36 episodes. It received positive reviews from critics.
